## Validation

List actual commands, results, browser/OS and manual checks. Mention external-service failures or runner-cleanup limits separately.

- [ ] `pnpm check` passed.
- [ ] Relevant behavioral/physics/compiler regressions were checked.
- [ ] Persian/English, keyboard focus and mobile layout were checked when affected.
- [ ] Documentation and translations were updated when affected.
- [ ] Dependencies are declared in the owning package; lockfile changes are intentional.
- [ ] Generated files, local profiles and secrets are excluded.

## Visual evidence or reproduction

For visual changes, include before/after screenshots. For bugs, include reproduction steps and expected results.

## Limits and compatibility

Describe relevant persistence/migration effects, runtime constraints or remaining unverified behavior.
